sunny_side_up.line: The sky is white, the ground is too,
there's not a single shade of blue,
but every flower wears a grin,
so come on in, come on in!
Sunny side up in Toonland town,
turn that frown upside down!
Hop on the checkers, one, two, three,
happy as a dino can be!
Old King Grumble stomps and roars,
he's grumpy on his checkered floors,
so bring a sword and bring a smile,
and cheer him up in cartoon style!
Sunny side up in Toonland town,
turn that frown upside down!
Hop on the checkers, one, two, three,
happy as a dino can be!
